doc: Per-hunter run speed and acceleration [game data]: SUPERVIVE's CT_LokiCharacterAttributes (MoveSpeed uu/s, MaxAcceleration uu/s^2), divided by 100 for metres. Ids are our archetypes: bulwark = Oath, dredge = Kingpin, thief = Shiv, mage = Joule, dolm = Tetra, ostra = Void, ashwick = Felix, juggernaut = Brall, archer = Myth, tender = Elluna, gunslinger = Ghost, rimewright = Celeste. climb_tall: the hunter can mantle double-high ledges (bCanWallJump: Myth and Brall only). A hunter not listed uses its class speed and the default accel.

physics.doc: Ground stop, dash exit, air, fall, glide, dive and mantle tunables shared by every hunter [game data]: BP_LokiHeroCharacter's movement component and the world settings, uu divided by 100 for metres. brake: BrakingDecelerationWalking (m/s^2), the constant part of the walking stop. ground_friction: GroundFriction (1/s) times braking_friction_factor (UE's BrakingFrictionFactor, default 2) is the share of the speed a let-go sheds per second. braking_substep: UE's BrakingSubStepTime (s, default 1/33): a longer step brakes in sub-steps of at most this. brake_stop_speed: UE's BRAKE_TO_STOP_VELOCITY 10 uu/s (m/s), a brake that leaves less stops dead. min_tick: UE's MIN_TICK_TIME (s), the shortest sub-step braked. Together (UE's ApplyVelocityBraking exactly) a let-go from a run stops in ~0.17 s and 0.31-0.37 m at our 60 Hz step; the source slides 0.28-0.33 m at 30 fps and 0.34-0.39 m at 144 fps (docs/MOVEMENT_PARITY.md). dash_exit_run: a dash ends at this share of run speed (never faster than the dash), so it carries into the walk, brake or jump instead of stopping dead; the data has no hard stop, and the dash curves that set the exact exit are not decoded. Air control is not here: the owner overruled SUPERVIVE's low AirControl (11-08), see content/rules/tuning.json air. fall_cap: AbyssFallSlowSpeedLimitMin (m/s), the fastest fall, easing to abyss_fall_cap between abyss_slow_from and abyss_slow_to metres under an island's lip over the abyss (AbyssFallSlowDistMin/Max). glide_height: GlideDownwardForceHeightTarget, above which the glider pulls you down at up to glide_pull_vy (GlideDownwardForceMinZVelocity); the drop never turns into speed (owner 11-08). glide_accel: GlideTargetXYForce 162,500 over the hunter's Mass 100 (m/s^2), the glider's pull toward where you steer at or under cruise, so a turn or a reversal has inertia (a reversal at cruise ~0.6 s). glide_start_vy: GlideStartFallSpeedMin (m/s), the slowest the glider falls the step it opens: a rising jump is cut to this fall, the open never adds speed (the matching Max, the fastest fall an open leaves you with, is locked: the canopy catch rate is ours, tuning.json glide.catch). turn_rate: RotationRate yaw (deg/s), how fast the body turns to the cursor: a fixed rate, so a small aim change lands at once and a 180 takes 0.14 s. mantle_vy_cap / mantle_pull: MantleSuctionUpwardsForceZSpeedCap (m/s) and MantleSuctionUpwardsForceMax over Mass 100 (m/s^2): within Hunter.MANTLE_REACH (MantleSuctionUpwardsForceHeightMax 1.5 m) under a lip the suction pulls you up only while you rise slower than the cap, so a jump's own momentum carries you over [?: the distance curve that scales the pull is not decoded; the max is used throughout]. mantle_launch_keep / mantle_launch_min: MiniMantleXYSpeedTargetCoefficient / Min, the speed onto a ledge you climb (share of run speed, at least this many m/s). dive_vy / dive_accel: GlideDiveZTargetSpeed (m/s) and GlideDiveZForceMax over the hunter's Mass (m/s^2), the glider's plunge while crouch is held under it; dive_steer: GlideDiveXYForceMultiplier, the share of the glide's steering force the keys keep in the plunge; dive_cancel_h: GlideDiveCancelDistance (m) above the ground where the plunge ends and the glide catches you; dive_timeout: GlideDiveTimeout (s) of holding before it ends on its own. coyote_s: s after walking off an edge in which a jump still counts as off the ground; jump_buffer_s: s before a landing in which a jump press is kept and fires as you land (both ours: the data has no such rows; the same in a match and on the farm). sneak_speed: SneakSpeedMultiplier, the share of run speed while crouched. A let-go under a cast's wind-up slow, a slow or a crouch brakes the same as the plain stop (UE brakes a let-go the same whatever the walk's cap is; --move-feel-check brake_cast_gap_m). floor_snap: MaxStepHeight 45 uu, how far the floor-find reaches down (m): a walk or a dash (both walking movement) stays on the ground when the ground under it drops this little in one step, so it hugs ramps and stairs and keeps its distance; a terrace (0.8 m) is a ledge and you leave it. walkable_angle: WalkableFloorAngle (deg): a step that moves you far reaches down as far as a slope this steep drops over it (a fast dash down stairs), never a whole tier. speed_cap: MaxMoveSpeed 700 uu/s (m/s), shared by all 12: the ground speed no stack of move-speed bonuses passes. Bonuses add (the source's MoveSpeed is one attribute and its Add modifiers sum, e.g. a kit's +75 with boots), slows and states then multiply that total, and the result clamps to speed_cap (HunterMove.ground_speed). haste: the shared haste status (stims, wards, a Boki's speed call) as a share of run speed [ours: the data has no generic haste]. mantle_launch_keep / mantle_launch_min: MiniMantleXYSpeedTargetCoefficient / Min, the speed over the lip of a ledge you climb: this share of the speed you came in with (MantleCarry), at least this many m/s (HunterMove.mantle_launch).

glide_spike.doc: A spiked glider (scripts/match/glide_spike.gd, docs/decisions/0022). Spiked by heat (a player's hit that fills the glider's heat, or any player hit on an overheated one) [wiki Spike] or by a slam (a dunk driving it down at slam_min m/s or more, whatever its heat) [wiki Dunk; data SpikeSlamForceStrengthThreshold, value not decoded, ours est]. land_stun: the stun when a spiked glider lands over ground [wiki 0.7 s]. land_dmg: the additional damage then [wiki: 'additional damage', amount not stated, ours est]. air_stun: s stunned while it falls. fall_vy: m/s, the heat spike's plunge at least (SpikeSlamForceZ, value not decoded, ours est); a slam keeps its own speed. keep_hv: the share of horizontal speed the spike keeps. reopen_cd: s before the glider can open again. cool_by: the heat a gliding spiker's own glider sheds [wiki: spiking cools you; KINFALL 50 of 100].
